item.title: typer 0.29.0 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: * `click_type` has been removed from `typer.Option()` and `typer.Argument()`. New ways to provide custom types will be provided with Pydantic, with much more flexibility. Quote: * Callback parameter objects no longer expose Click's `.type`, `.make_metavar()`, `.human_readable_name`, or `.type_cast_value()`. Custom integrations using these need updating. Release notes: https://github.com/fastapi/typer/releases/tag/0.29.0
